'''Silmis Vey''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] who served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] as a [[Jedi General/Legends|General]] in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
A [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Gender/Legends|male]], Silmis Vey received [[Jedi training/Legends|training]] in the ways of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], achieving the rank of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] before the time of the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]]. During this time, Vey selected the young [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|Initiate]], [[Mariineh]], as his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]].<ref name="OTF" />

When the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] erupted between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], Vey took up the rank of [[Jedi General/Legends|General]] in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]]. While Mariineh had nearly completed her training and was ready to take her [[Jedi Trials/Legends|Trials of Knighthood]], the girl volunteered to accompany her master to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Argul]] to participate in the [[Battle of Argul|Republic offensive]] there. Proud of her choice and the responsibility it demonstrated, Vey and his student participated from orbit, overseeing the evacuation of transports from Argul to a rendezvous point near [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]].<ref name="OTF" />
